tools.name: hubspot_list_objects
tools.description: List contacts, companies, deals or tickets, one page at a time. Pass the returned paging cursor to get the next page. HubSpot API: GET /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}.

tools.name: hubspot_get_object
tools.description: Get one contact, company, deal or ticket by id, with the requested properties and associated record ids. HubSpot API: GET /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}/{objectId}.

tools.name: hubspot_search_objects
tools.description: Search contacts, companies, deals or tickets with property filters (up to 5 filter groups, 6 filters each, ANDed inside a group and ORed across groups), a sort and a free-text query. Returns up to 200 records per page. HubSpot API: POST /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}/search. This only reads data.

tools.name: hubspot_create_object
tools.description: Create a contact, company, deal or ticket with the given property values. This writes new data to the customer's HubSpot account. HubSpot API: POST /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}.

tools.name: hubspot_update_object
tools.description: Change the given property values of one contact, company, deal or ticket. Properties not listed keep their values. This changes data in the customer's HubSpot account. HubSpot API: PATCH /crm/objects/2026-09/{objectType}/{objectId}.

tools.name: hubspot_list_owners
tools.description: List the users who own CRM records (name, email, user id). Use the owner id in the hubspot_ownerid property. HubSpot API: GET /crm/owners/2026-09.

tools.name: hubspot_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the pipelines and their stages for deals or tickets, with stage ids for filtering and updates. HubSpot API: GET /crm/pipelines/2026-09/{objectType}.

tools.name: hubspot_list_properties
tools.description: List the property definitions of a contact, company, deal or ticket (internal name, label, type, options). Use it to find the internal names before a search or an update. HubSpot API: GET /crm/properties/2026-09/{objectType}.

tools.name: hubspot_read_associations
tools.description: Read which records of one type are linked to records of another type, for up to 100 source ids per call (for example, the companies linked to some contacts). HubSpot API: POST /crm/associations/2026-09/{fromObjectType}/{toObjectType}/batch/read. This only reads data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hubspot_list_objects, hubspot_get_object, hubspot_search_objects, hubspot_list_owners, hubspot_list_pipelines, hubspot_list_properties, hubspot_read_associations · Private data: hubspot_list_objects, hubspot_get_object, hubspot_search_objects, hubspot_create_object, hubspot_update_object, hubspot_list_owners, hubspot_list_properties, hubspot_read_associations · Public sink: hubspot_search_objects, hubspot_create_object, hubspot_list_owners, hubspot_read_associations.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hubspot_list_objects, hubspot_get_object, hubspot_search_objects, hubspot_list_owners, hubspot_list_pipelines, hubspot_list_properties, hubspot_read_associations · Private data: hubspot_list_objects, hubspot_get_object, hubspot_search_objects, hubspot_create_object, hubspot_update_object, hubspot_list_owners, hubspot_list_properties, hubspot_read_associations · Public sink: hubspot_search_objects, hubspot_create_object, hubspot_list_owners, hubspot_read_associations

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
